meta.product_timing: transcript block start times ([m:ss], 1 s), one constant shift per meeting onto AMI time; growth 'start' = block starts only (recorded), 'span' = also each second of a block's estimated speaking time (ASSUMED 2.6 words/s)
meta.variants: VAD/growth: energy or oracle VAD; start or span transcript growth
meta.selection: DEV: false alarms <= 2.0/h, then max recall, then min median delay, then larger T / min_speech / margin
meta.method: Alert at second t if no product transcript block started in (t-T, t] and the VAD heard >= min_speech*T s of speech in that stretch; one alert per transcript silence. Energy VAD: 20 ms frames, voiced if > margin_db above the causal 10th-percentile floor of the previous 120 s and > -60 dBFS. Oracle VAD: AMI word timings. Ground truth: coverage-scorer gaps >= 30 s. Faults: one seeded deletion (30-300 s) of product blocks per trial.
meta.corpus: AMI Meeting Corpus manual annotations 1.6.2 and Mix-Headset audio (CC BY 4.0)
